text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said its analyst Shelly Hale Young raised her rating on shares of apparel maker dELIA*s to strong buy from buy based on strong holiday demand, high fill rates and low returns.
-- In a statement, Hale Young said she expects the company "to post significant upside to our Q4 EPS estimate of $0.05 a share." One year ago, dELIA*s earned $0.01 per share.
-- Also, the analyst said 1997 "is shaping up to be even better than we expected" with consumer appeal "accelerating."
-- The company is expected to report fourth quarter and year 1996 results on March 17, according to Hambrecht & Quist.
